the automated testing of programs is not enough to assess the skills and knowledge obtained by the students in the high school curriculum.

1. the automated testing is a good tool to evaluate the students' knowledge of basic programming constructs, but 2. the students' knowledge and skills in the areas of program design, program style and programming techniques are not sufficiently covered by the automated testing.
the students are capable to write programs which are not evaluated by the automatic testing environment.

the quality of the automatic testing environment and the manual assessment of program code.
the evaluation of program constructs, the quality of program codes, and the students' skills and knowledge in programming.
